name: bb_squeeze_breakout_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: When NIFTY's 5-minute Bollinger Band width compresses below the 10th-15th percentile of the prior 1-hour distribution, systematic market-making algos narrow their quotes and momentum programs stand aside — the index is in a low-uncertainty microstructure regime with order flow evenly balanced. The breakout fires when NIFTY closes outside the compressed band on above-average volume, triggering cascading entries from rule-based trend-following algorithms and breakout systems that share similar momentum filters. On NIFTY specifically, these cascades sustain for 30-90 seconds because FII-dominated institutional flow executes in TWAP/VWAP waves, meaning the initial breakout price is only partially absorbed and each subsequent 5-second bar sees renewed directional order pressure — a directional autocorrelation window that equity names lack.

indicators.name: bb_mid_60
indicators.purpose: 5-minute SMA as BB midline. Period chosen at 60 bars (5 min) because the squeeze must be a compression meaningful to our 30-90s hold — a 5-min squeeze is tight enough to signal coiling energy but not so short it fires on tick noise. The original 20-bar at 1-min also equals 20 minutes, which is too long for a 30-90s trade; 5-min compression is the fastest regime that still has directional follow-through.

indicators.name: bb_std_60
indicators.purpose: Rolling standard deviation for BB width calculation, same 60-bar window as midline.

indicators.name: bb_width_60
indicators.purpose: Normalized bandwidth = (upper - lower) / mid. Normalization removes level dependence so percentile is meaningful across different NIFTY price levels.

indicators.name: bb_width_pctile_720
indicators.purpose: Percentile rank of current bandwidth vs prior 1-hour (720 bars). The original used 120 bars at 1-min = 2-hour context. Compressed to 1 hour at 5s because we want the squeeze relative to the CURRENT SESSION volatility regime, not yesterday's. Intraday NIFTY volatility clusters by session phase (opening high, midday low, closing high), so comparing to today's 1-hour window is more relevant than the original's 2-hour all-day window. NOT a naive 12x scale — this is a deliberate compression to session-relative context.

indicators.name: vol_sma_60
indicators.purpose: 5-minute average volume as volume-surge baseline. NIFTY index volume is noisier than individual stocks, so we use 5-min average to smooth while still detecting genuine breakout surges (> 1.5x average).

conditions: close > bb_mid_60 + 2 * bb_std_60 (close above upper band)
buy_ce.confirmation: Single bar close outside compressed band with volume surge — no multi-bar wait because at 5s the breakout move starts immediately and waiting 2 bars wastes 10 seconds of the move.

conditions: close < bb_mid_60 - 2 * bb_std_60 (close below lower band)
buy_pe.confirmation: Single bar close outside compressed band with volume surge.

exit.stop_rationale: 4 option pts = ~8 NIFTY spot point reversal. A genuine BB breakout from a 5-min squeeze should NOT retrace 8 spot points within 30-90 seconds — if it does, the squeeze resolved as a false breakout (supply absorbed the demand immediately). For a 5-min compression, a 4-pt stop captures the 'thesis failed within first 30s' scenario without being stopped by normal 1-3 pt bid-ask noise.
exit.target_rationale: 7 option pts = ~14 NIFTY spot points. When NIFTY breaks out of a 5-min Bollinger squeeze, the first institutional TWAP wave typically moves the index 15-25 spot points before partial fill completion. At delta ~0.5, that's 7.5-12.5 option pts. Targeting 7 pts captures the lower end of the first wave (1:1.75 R:R), maximizing frequency without overfitting to the peak move.

filters.vix_filter: VIX 11-24; below 11 = extremely low vol / thin market where BB squeezes give no energy; above 24 = high-vol regime where band width fluctuates wildly and squeeze percentile becomes unreliable
filters.time_filter: 09:30-15:20 IST; skip first 15 min (opening gap absorption, pre-open auction unwinds distort bands); skip last 10 min (EOD position squaring creates fake breakouts)
filters.volume_filter: volume > 1.5x 60-bar SMA; NIFTY volume spikes on genuine institutional breakouts — no spike means no conviction
filters.trend_filter: none deliberately — squeeze breakout direction is reactive (trade the direction of the break), not predicted
filters.spread_filter: n/a — limit order execution at candle close

edge.edge_decay_risk: medium — BB squeeze on indices is known but less competed than on individual stocks since NIFTY requires institutional-grade access; however, risk is that HFT algos front-run the same breakout level

adaptation_notes: Original equity strategy: traded individual FNO stocks (NIFTY200) on 1-min bars, held 20-120 minutes, used 120-bar percentile window (2 hours). Three key adaptations: (1) Shifted to NIFTY index — eliminates stock-specific gap risk, gains FII institutional flow dynamics; (2) Compressed to 5-min BB period (60 bars) from 20-min (20 bars at 1-min) — the 5-min compression is specifically chosen because our hold is 30-90s, not 20-120min; we catch the initial breakout momentum, not the full trend; (3) Reduced percentile window to 720 bars (1 hour) from 120 bars at 1-min (2 hours) — we need session-relative compression, not all-day comparison, because NIFTY intraday vol has strong session-phase clustering. The key insight preserved: volume-confirmed breakout from compressed bands has momentum autocorrelation. What's different: we target the first NIFTY TWAP wave (30-90s autocorrelation window), not the full equity trend.
weaknesses: NIFTY volume data at 5s is noisy and sparse — volume surge filter may fire on illiquid moments or miss genuine breaks
BB squeeze at 5-min frequency generates more false squeezes than daily compression; squeeze detection quality depends heavily on the 15th percentile threshold calibration
The original explicitly noted 'breakout direction is unknown' — this is still true; win rate is inherently capped by 50% theoretical base rate; only volume + VWAP alignment improves it modestly
BB is widely known — other algos may trigger at the same breakout level, creating congestion rather than continuation in the first few bars
